theme: Hybrid Strategy. Landing Page: Light Theme (clean, trustworthy, B2B wholesale). ERP/Dashboard: Light Theme with structural grayscale. POS Module: High-Contrast Dark Mode option or highly focused Light Mode with stark borders to reduce eye strain and increase focus for fast operations.

rules.headings: Use Outfit. font-black or font-bold, tight tracking (tracking-tighter). Avoid default weights. Do not use Inter for headings.
rules.body: Use Inter for dense ERP data and tables to ensure maximum legibility.

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) mixed with Industrial Accents
colors.rules: Avoid generic SaaS blue. Use Industrial Blue (#0055A4) for trust and Safety Orange (#FF5A00) exclusively for primary CTAs (e.g., 'Cobrar' in POS). Do not use Teal (#1B93A4).

visual_enhancers.landing_page: Crystal Glassmorphism for sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-white/40). Large typography, generous padding.
visual_enhancers.erp_pos: Technical Grid Borders. Expose the skeleton for tables and dashboards. 1px solid borders (border-border), flat backgrounds. Max 6px border-radius (rounded-md) for a sharp, professional look.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm for cards. Avoid large diffuse shadows in ERP to maintain data clarity.

components_usage.buttons: Landing: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). ERP/POS: Sharp/slightly rounded (rounded-md). Always define explicit hover text colors (hover:bg-primary-hover hover:text-white).
components_usage.inputs: Shadcn UI Input/Select. Use h-9 or h-10 for standard, h-12 for POS search bar (large tap target).
components_usage.tables: Shadcn Table. Sticky headers. Compact padding (p-2 or p-3) for dense inventory data. Alternating row colors or clear hover states (hover:bg-slate-50).
components_usage.cards: Cardless or flat 1px border. Do not overuse thick cards. Keep it clean.
components_usage.sidebar: Collapsible to icon-only mode to save space for the POS and Dashboard.
components_usage.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog. Backdrop blur for focus.

grids_and_layouts.landing: Tetris Bento Grid (Mode A) for featured categories. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, gap-8. Asymmetrical spans.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4, gap-4 or gap-6. Top row for 4 key KPI cards. Below: 2/3 chart, 1/3 recent activity.
grids_and_layouts.pos_module: Split Layout. Left (65%): Search bar, category filters, and dense product grid. Right (35%): Fixed Cart/Ticket summary, total, and Checkout (Cobrar) button. Optimized for tablet/PC.

motion.rules: Micro-interactions only in ERP to prioritize speed. Hover states must have transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease. Avoid heavy page transitions in POS.
motion.landing: Staggered fade-up for hero elements. Smooth scroll (Lenis style).

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Dark text on light backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: MANDATORY: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, and key data points MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='pos-search-input', data-testid='checkout-button').

media.rules: Use provided Unsplash URLs. Never use generic placeholder text/images. Optimize for B2B industrial look.

image_urls.description: Warehouse with stacked white bags. Use with a dark or gradient overlay for text readability.
Brown paper bag for product category card.

libraries.icons: lucide-react (Standard, pre-installed). Ensure stroke-width is 1.5 or 2 for clarity.
libraries.toast: sonner (Use for success/error alerts in POS and Inventory)

instructions_to_main_agent: Language: Entire UI MUST be in ESPAÑOL (Dashboard, Productos, POS, Caja, Clientes).
POS Priority: The Punto de Venta screen must prioritize speed. Include quick quantity adjustments, easy product search, and a large 'Cobrar' button. Optimize layout for Desktop and Tablet.
Data Tables: Inventory and Product tables must have clear visual states for stock (e.g., green dot for In Stock, red dot for Out of Stock, yellow for Low Stock).
Forms: Use tabbed forms (Shadcn Tabs) for complex product creation (General, Precios, Stock, Imágenes).
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold: use asymmetrical grids for the landing page and highly technical, sharp borders for the ERP.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep ERP surfaces flat and clean.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition: transform 0.2s, opacity 0.2s`.
Do not center-align the app container. Use left-aligned layouts for data grids and tables.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use lucide-react.
MUST include `data-testid` on all interactive and key informational elements.
